dataCollected.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataCollected.intro: We collect the following data in the context of our WhatsApp CRM platform:
items: Account data: name, email address, password hash
WhatsApp contact data received via WhatsApp Cloud API: phone number, display name, profile picture when available
Message content: text, media files, documents, and audio exchanged via WhatsApp
Message metadata: timestamps, delivery status, and read receipts
Usage data: access logs, IP address, and session data

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
items: Customer service management via shared inbox
Message automation and notification delivery
CRM: contact management, pipelines, and conversation history
Analytics and performance metrics
Legal compliance and fraud prevention
use.noAiAds: WhatsApp message data is never used to train AI models or for targeted advertising.

sharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
items: Meta Platforms Inc. (WhatsApp): messaging infrastructure operator under the WhatsApp Business Terms of Service
Supabase Inc.: database and authentication provider
Competent authorities: when required by law or court order
sharing.outro: We do not sell, rent, or share personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.

international.title: 5. International Transfer
international.body: Message data may be transferred to Meta Platforms Inc. servers in the United States for processing via WhatsApp Cloud API, subject to Meta's standard contractual clauses and in compliance with LGPD art. 33.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
items: Account and contact data: retained while the account is active
WhatsApp message data: retained for 12 months from the date of the conversation
All data deleted within 30 days of account closure or upon verified request
Security logs: retained for up to 12 months as required by law

rights.title: 7. Your Rights (LGPD art. 18)
items: Access: confirm whether your data is processed and obtain a copy
Correction: fix incomplete or inaccurate data
Deletion: request removal of unnecessary or unlawfully processed data
Portability: receive your data in a structured format
Consent withdrawal: revoke consent at any time
Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interest
Information: know which third parties receive your data
rights.outro: To exercise any right, contact us at {email}. We respond within 15 business days.

dpo.title: 8. Data Protection Officer (DPO)
dpo.anpd: You may also file a complaint with the Brazilian data protection authority (ANPD):

security.title: 9. Security
items: AES-256-GCM encryption for tokens and credentials at rest
HTTPS/TLS for all communications
Two-factor authentication (2FA) enforced for admin accounts
Role-based access control

updates.title: 10. Updates to this Policy
updates.body: We may update this policy periodically. Significant changes will be communicated by email or in-app notification. The effective date at the top of this document reflects the most recent version.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance
acceptance.body: By accessing or using {companyName}, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

service.title: 3. Description of Service
service.body: {companyName} is a SaaS CRM and communication platform built on the WhatsApp Business API (Meta), enabling:
items: Customer service via shared inbox
Message automation and flows
Contact management, pipelines, and broadcast campaigns
Template management via WhatsApp Cloud API
service.outro: {companyName} operates as a Meta Tech Provider, connecting client WhatsApp Business Accounts to the official Cloud API.

permitted.title: 4. Permitted Use
items: Use the platform only for lawful and legitimate business purposes
Comply with the WhatsApp Business Policy
Obtain explicit opt-in consent from recipients before sending marketing messages
Keep your credentials confidential and not share account access
Ensure all message content is accurate, legal, and not misleading

prohibited.title: 5. Prohibited Use
items: Sending spam or unsolicited messages to contacts who have not opted in
Using the platform in restricted industries listed in the Acceptable Use Policy
Buying, selling, or renting contact lists
Impersonating any person, business, or brand
Attempting to circumvent WhatsApp Cloud API rate limits
Any fraudulent, illegal, or abusive activity
Reselling or sublicensing access without express written authorization
Reverse engineering, decompiling, or extracting source code

responsibilities.title: 6. Responsibilities
providerItems: Complying with Meta/WhatsApp Tech Provider requirements
Protecting data as described in the Privacy Policy
customerItems: All content of messages sent through the platform
Obtaining and maintaining opt-in consent from their end contacts
Compliance with WhatsApp policies when communicating with their own customers
Ensuring their use does not violate applicable laws

ip.title: 7. Intellectual Property
ip.body: The software, trademarks, and content of {companyName} are protected by applicable law. Use of the service does not transfer any intellectual property rights to the customer.

termination.title: 8. Suspension and Termination
termination.body: {companyName} may suspend or terminate access immediately and without prior notice in cases of:
items: Violation of these Terms or the Acceptable Use Policy
Abuse of the platform or harm to third parties
Requirement from Meta/WhatsApp or competent authorities
Non-payment where applicable

liability.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: {companyName} is not liable for damages arising from:
items: Unavailability of Meta/WhatsApp infrastructure
Misuse of the platform by the customer or their end users
Changes to Meta's policies or API that affect service functionality
Events outside reasonable control (force majeure)

law.title: 10. Governing Law
law.body: These Terms are governed by Brazilian law. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of {city}, Brazil, to the exclusion of any other jurisdiction.

changes.title: 11. Changes
changes.body: We may update these Terms at any time. Users will be notified by email of material changes. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.body: This Acceptable Use Policy applies to all customers, users, and organizations accessing {companyName} services. {companyName}, operated by {companyLegalName} (CNPJ {cnpj}), is a Meta Tech Provider platform. We are responsible for enforcing these rules across all accounts and ensuring compliance with Meta's platform policies.
scope.outro: Violation of this policy may result in immediate suspension and reporting to Meta.

prohibited.title: 2. Prohibited Industries and Content
prohibited.body: The following industries, products, and content types are strictly prohibited on this platform, in alignment with Meta's Commerce and Advertising Policies:
items: Unregulated gambling or online casinos without a valid license in the jurisdiction
Firearms, ammunition, explosives, or weapons of any kind
Adult content or pornography
Prescription drugs, controlled substances, or pharmaceuticals sold without prescription
Unregulated cryptocurrencies, financial pyramid schemes, or fraudulent investment offers
Tobacco, e-cigarettes, and vaping products where prohibited by applicable law
Hate speech, violence, or discrimination based on protected characteristics
Counterfeit goods or intellectual property infringement
Human trafficking or exploitation
Any product, service, or content that is illegal in the recipient's jurisdiction

consent.title: 3. Consent (Opt-In) Requirements
consent.body: All customers must comply with the following consent rules:
items: Every contact receiving marketing or automated messages must have given explicit opt-in consent before the first message
Opt-in cannot be presumed from a prior business relationship for marketing messages
Opt-in evidence must be retained: date, channel, and the exact consent text shown
Contacts must be able to opt out at any time; opt-out requests must be honored within 24 hours
Purchased, rented, or scraped contact lists are prohibited

messaging.title: 4. Messaging Rules
items: Do not send messages at a volume or frequency that constitutes spam
Only use Meta-approved message templates for outbound messages outside the 24-hour service window
Do not attempt to circumvent WhatsApp Cloud API rate limits or quality scoring
Do not send identical bulk messages outside approved broadcast flows
Message content must match the approved template category

technical.title: 5. Prohibited Technical Actions
items: Reverse engineering, decompiling, or extracting the platform's source code
Attempting to gain unauthorized access to other accounts or data
Injecting malicious code, scripts, or payloads via the platform
Using automated tools to scrape data from the platform
Reselling or sublicensing API access to third parties without written authorization

impersonation.title: 6. Impersonation
impersonation.body: Using the platform to impersonate any person, business, government entity, or brand is strictly prohibited, including use of unauthorized logos, trademarks, or sender names.

abuse.title: 7. Reporting Abuse
abuse.body: To report violations of this policy, contact our abuse team:
abuse.response: We commit to responding within 48 business hours.
abuse.meta: Reports to Meta may also be submitted directly at:

consequences.title: 8. Consequences of Violation
consequences.body: Violations of this policy may result in:
items: Immediate suspension of account access without refund
Permanent termination of the account
Reporting to Meta Platforms Inc. as required by our Tech Provider agreement
Reporting to law enforcement or regulatory authorities when legally required
Civil or criminal legal action where applicable

operator.title: 9. Operator Responsibility
operator.body: {companyName} ({companyLegalName}) is responsible, as a Meta Tech Provider, for enforcing this policy across all customer accounts on the platform. We reserve the right to review account activity, remove content, and suspend accounts that violate this policy or Meta's platform terms, without prior notice.

updates.title: 10. Updates
updates.body: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in Meta's platform requirements or applicable law. The effective date at the top reflects the current version.

Meta test numbers have no PIN and are pre-registered — leave this blank for them. Leaving it blank also keeps an existing registration untouched.
